person.shortBio: Associate Full Stack Developer at Fountane, working with Next.js and Go. I own features end to end, and I'm currently building an AI chatbot agent that lets users query a large system in plain language.
longBio: I'm a software developer from Patna, India. I started building for the web while studying Computer Applications at Patna University, contributed to open source with Real Dev Squad, and joined Fountane in August 2024 as a Junior Full Stack Developer. I was recently promoted to Associate Full Stack Developer.

Day to day I work across Next.js and Go: UI with Ant Design, backend services and APIs, payment integrations, and role-based access control. I use AI tools like Claude, Cursor and Antigravity as part of how I build, and I'm now working on an AI chatbot agent that answers natural-language questions by calling internal APIs through an LLM.
Outside code I ride. I have ridden solo from Patna to Ladakh and from Patna to Rameshwaram, and I document the road, the people and the lessons on a separate Rides page.

projects.title: CareRing
projects.summary: Privacy-first real-time family location intelligence, safety, and emergency response platform with sub-50ms WebSocket telemetry propagation, geofencing, and sub-1% battery drain.
projects.description: CareRing is an open-source, production-engineered family safety ecosystem designed with zero telemetry monetization. Hardware-accelerated motion coprocessor filtering with sub-1% battery drain per hour.
Dynamic geofencing with PostGIS spatial indexing for instant safe-zone arrival/departure triggers.
One-touch emergency SOS broadcast with zero-knowledge encrypted contact alerts.

projects.title: Home Asset Manager
projects.summary: A personal digital operating system for household assets, purchase invoices, warranty lifecycles, and automated maintenance schedules with multimodal AI invoice OCR.
projects.description: Turborepo monorepo encompassing a Next.js 14 web dashboard, React Native mobile app with camera viewfinder capture, and a modular Node.js/TypeScript backend. Features Gemini 2.5 Flash multimodal OCR for invoice extraction and Redis/BullMQ background queues for automated warranty expiration and appliance maintenance reminders.
highlights: Turborepo monorepo sharing strict Zod schemas and validation models across web, mobile, and API.
Gemini 2.5 Flash multimodal OCR for automated extraction of invoice serial numbers, vendors, and warranty dates.
Distributed BullMQ background job queues with Redis for warranty expiry alerts and recurring maintenance reminders.
Multi-platform UI with Next.js 14 App Router for desktop management and Expo React Native for mobile camera capture.

projects.title: GitTrackr
projects.summary: An engineering management dashboard that allows engineering teams and open-source organizations to monitor, triage, and manage GitHub issues, PRs, and contributor velocity.
projects.description: Built with Next.js, NextAuth, and React Query, GitTrackr connects to the GitHub REST and GraphQL APIs to provide unified multi-repo issue triage, pull request lifecycle tracking, team velocity summaries, and contributor activity graphs with Vitest test coverage.

GitHub OAuth authentication via NextAuth with fine-grained repository access scopes.
Real-time data synchronization using React Query with optimistic UI updates and cache invalidation.
Comprehensive test coverage with Vitest and React Testing Library for mission-critical triage flows.

MongoDB schema design with Mongoose handling link order, click counters, and social icons.
Secure authentication with NextAuth and MongoDB adapter for seamless link dashboard management.
Fully responsive mobile-first UI with custom themes, drag-and-drop link ordering, and share previews.

page.title: On Two Wheels
page.tagline: Patna to the edge of the map, and back.
page.intro: When I'm not shipping code, I'm on a motorcycle. These are my long solo rides: the routes, the stories, the telemetry, and what the road taught me.

rides.title: Patna to Ladakh
rides.summary: A 3,850 km solo motorcycle expedition from the plains of Patna across Rohtang, Baralacha La, and Tanglang La to Khardung La at 17,590 ft.
rides.story: Leaving the sweltering 42°C heat of Patna behind, this solo journey was about testing grit on a Royal Enfield Meteor 350. Climbing from sea-level plains up into the freezing passes of the Great Himalayas proved that the J-series engine's steady low-end torque is built for high-altitude mountain climbs.

waypoints.name: Varanasi
waypoints.note: First fuel stop and evening Ganga Aarti.

waypoints.name: Keylong / Jispa
waypoints.note: Atal Tunnel transit into Lahaul Valley.

waypoints.name: Sarchu
waypoints.note: Freezing winds at 14,000 ft border camp.

highlights: Conquered Khardung La at 17,590 ft on the Royal Enfield Meteor 350.
Navigated freezing water crossings at Pagal Nallah and snow blizzards on Baralacha La.
Camped by Pangong Tso at 14,270 ft with freezing -2°C night winds.
Maintained 100% mechanical reliability across 3,850 km of rugged mountain terrain.

dayByDay.note: Early morning start avoiding highway traffic.
Transitioning from plains to mountain foothills.
Crossing through Atal Tunnel into Lahaul.
Baralacha La pass crossing at 16,040 ft.
Gata Loops and More Plains crossing.
Ascended to the highest motorable road.

lessons: AMS (Acute Mountain Sickness) is real: hydrate aggressively with electrolytes and ascend gradually.
Keep weight centered and low on the rear subframe to maintain front tire steering in gravel.
The Meteor 350's low-end 27 Nm torque makes hair-pin climbs smooth without constant downshifts.

rides.title: Patna to Rameshwaram
rides.summary: A 5,420 km solo motorcycle ride slicing from North India down the spine of the Deccan Plateau to the Pamban Sea Bridge and Dhanushkodi.
rides.story: Riding from the Ganga basin to the confluence of the Indian Ocean and the Bay of Bengal. Across 9 states, this expedition was about enduring intense heat shifts, coastal crosswinds, and endless asphalt marathons.

waypoints.name: Pamban Sea Bridge
waypoints.note: Ocean sea crossing on two wheels.

waypoints.name: Dhanushkodi
waypoints.note: Edge of the Indian map reached.

highlights: Solo coast-to-coast sprint slicing across 9 Indian states and 5,420 km.
Crossed the legendary Pamban Sea Bridge surrounded by open ocean crosswinds.
Stood at Dhanushkodi—the ghost town at the exact boundary of India and Sri Lankan waters.
Zero chain drops or tire failures thanks to strict 500 km maintenance protocols.
lessons: Crosswinds on sea bridges and coastal highways require firm knee-grip on the fuel tank.
Clean and lube the drive chain every 500 km, especially after salt air and beach sand.
Hydration tablets are just as crucial in 40°C humid south heat as in Ladakh.

bikeDetails.name: Royal Enfield Meteor 350
bikeDetails.engine: 349cc Single Cylinder, 4-stroke, Air-Oil Cooled SOHC J-Series Engine
bikeDetails.rangeKm: ~480 km per tank (32-35 km/L highway touring)

bikeDetails.tagline: The Highway Cruiser Built for Mountain Passes & Ocean Highways
bikeDetails.description: My primary solo touring steed. Built on Royal Enfield's twin downtube spine frame with counterbalanced J-series single-cylinder thumper, delivering buttery smooth cruising without handlebar vibration at 90-100 km/h.
whyThisBike: Low Center of Gravity & 765mm Seat Height: Enables full-foot plant control during treacherous slush and icy gravel hairpins in Ladakh.
Bottom-End Thump (27 Nm @ 4,000 RPM): Seamless hill-climbing without frequent gear hunting on 17,000 ft Himalayan switchbacks.
480 km Realistic Fuel Range: Vital for crossing remote fuel-dry stretches like the 365 km stretch between Tandi and Karu in Ladakh.
Rock-solid Mechanical Reliability: Zero engine breakdown or mechanical drop across 15,480 km of solo cross-country touring.

plannedRides.title: Spiti Valley & Sach Pass Circuit
plannedRides.summary: Tackling the most treacherous cliff-carved mountain roads on earth: Hindustan-Tibet Highway, high-altitude desert of Kaza, Kunzum La, and the notorious Sach Pass cliff-hangers.
plannedRides.description: A high-risk, high-reward trans-Himalayan circuit that tests motorcycle clearance, water-crossing navigation, and high-altitude solo endurance. Entering through Shimla and the Kinnaur gorge, ascending to Tabo and Key Monastery at 12,000 ft, traversing Kunzum Pass (14,931 ft), and descending through the sheer rock walls of Sach Pass (14,482 ft) in Pangi Valley.
highlights: Navigating the sheer cliff-cut corridors of the Hindustan-Tibet highway.
Summiting Kunzum La (14,931 ft) and camping near the Chandratal glacial crescent.
Conquering Sach Pass (14,482 ft) — known as India's most treacherous single-lane mountain road.
Field testing cold-weather engine thermal management and air filtration in Spiti desert dust.

checkpoints.note: Cliff corridors alongside the roaring Satluj river.
High-altitude desert base camp & monastery plateaus.
High mountain pass linking Spiti to Lahaul.

plannedRides.summary: Cross-border expedition from Patna across the Dooars tea gardens into the Kingdom of Bhutan, ascending to Chele La Pass at 13,084 ft.
plannedRides.description: An international motorcycle journey threading through North Bengal tea country to Phuentsholing, climbing into the mystical fortress valleys of Thimphu and Paro, and ascending the highest motorable road in Bhutan at Chele La with panoramas of Mt. Jomolhari.
highlights: International overland border crossing at Phuentsholing on two wheels.
Riding the immaculate winding alpine curves through Thimphu and Punakha Dzongs.
Summiting Chele La Pass at 13,084 ft overlooking the sacred Himalayan snow peaks.
Experiencing Bhutan's Carbon-Negative roads and preservation-first mountain ethos.
